hook: Your app works on your laptop only?
title: What is a Container?
analogy: A shipping box with your app and everything it needs
points: Runs the same on any machine
question: Docker or Podman: which do you use?
voiceover: Your app works on your laptop, but breaks on the server? A container fixes that. Think of it as a shipping box. It packs your code, libraries and config, runs the same everywhere, and starts in seconds.
caption: Containers explained in 15 seconds. Docker or Podman: which do you use?
